title: Procedurally generated CQB in mixed reality
author: No_Coast_1953

comments.author: lordpoee
comments.body: ow much of this is purely procedural?

replies.author: No_Coast_1953
replies.body: just depends on your definition of procedural. It's not as deep as no mans sky.   The outer walls stay the same, the assets are limited but the rooms spawn in random configurations every time you play with random NPCs types and numbers.

replies.author: lordpoee
replies.body: Oh, so the map is procedural
